h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert E.is_dir() and closure.is_file() and not closure.is_symlink();assert h(closure)==expectedClosureSha

p=E/'recovery.sb'
if p.exists():assert p.read_text()==policy
else:p.open('x').write(policy)

for mode in ['prepare','before-run','after']:

 record={'schema':'fvs/owned-continuous-driver','version':1,'scope':'proposal fixed one-root sequence; no retry orB/E2 loop','controllerPins':pins,'events':events,'status':'stopped' if r.returncode else 'stage-completed'}
 (E/('driver-'+mode+'.json')).open('x').write(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
